name_zh: 马尔代夫·穆罕默德·纳希德：民主气候与岛国生存
name_en: Maldives Mohamed Nasheed: Democracy Climate & Island Survival
description_zh: 穆罕默德·纳希德 (1967-) 马尔代夫首位民选总统 (2008-2012)，气候正义代言人，水下内阁会议警示海平面上升，2012年政变下台流亡，持续推动全球气候行动与民主复苏。
description_en: Mohamed Nasheed (1967-) Maldives first democratically elected President (2008-2012), climate justice spokesman, underwater cabinet meeting warned sea level rise, 2012 coup ousted exiled, continues advocating global climate action and democratic revival.
reason_zh: 纳希德代表沉没岛国如何通过气候外交争取生存话语权，展示了民主领袖如何将国家生存危机转化为全球道德领导力，其水下内阁会议成为气候外交经典案例。
reason_en: Nasheed represents how sinking island state contests survival discourse through climate diplomacy, demonstrating how democratic leader transforms national existential crisis into global moral leadership, his underwater cabinet meeting becoming climate diplomacy classic case.
steps_zh: 研究纳希德早年记者与反戈登独裁监狱岁月
分析2008年首位民选总统与气候正义外交启动
探讨2009年水下内阁会议哥本哈根峰会发声
评估2012年政变下台流亡与持续国际倡导
总结民主气候流亡岛国生存对全球气候治理的道德挑战
steps_en: Study Nasheed early journalist and anti-Gayoom dictatorship prison years
Analyze 2008 first elected President and climate justice diplomacy launch
Explore 2009 underwater cabinet meeting Copenhagen summit voice
Evaluate 2012 coup ousting exile and continued international advocacy
Summarize democracy climate exile island survival moral challenge for global climate governance
expected_zh: 理解岛国生存危机如何重塑民主领袖国际角色，掌握气候外交如何超越主权平等原则成为道德杠杆，评估纳希德模式对图瓦卢基里巴斯等沉没国家的示范价值。
expected_en: Understand how island existential crisis reshapes democratic leader international role, grasp how climate diplomacy transcends sovereign equality becoming moral lever, evaluate Nasheed model demonstration for Tuvalu Kiribati sinking nations.
case_zh: 1967 出生；2008 总统；2009 水下内阁；2012 政变。民主气候流亡岛国生存范式永存。
case_en: 1967 birth; 2008 President; 2009 underwater cabinet; 2012 coup. Democracy climate exile island survival paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Climate diplomacy; underwater cabinet; island survival; democratic advocacy
